description: Restoring the chosen tree's elided terminators can reject every reading: the lookahead of a sees the restored KU. With no derivation of the restored text, no two readings exist to report, so the check passes (engine §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy elision-only
%elidable KU
%rule text a | c
%rule a $x(A) [KU]
%conditions ¬begins(after($x), k)
%rule c A d
%rule d ε
%rule k KU
